```{r}
gg_qqplot <- function(ps, ci = 0.95, title = "QQ Plot") {
  n <- length(ps)
  df <- data.frame(
    observed = -log10(sort(ps)),
    expected = -log10(ppoints(n)),
    clower = -log10(qbeta(p = (1 - ci) / 2, shape1 = 1:n, shape2 = n:1)),
    cupper = -log10(qbeta(p = (1 + ci) / 2, shape1 = 1:n, shape2 = n:1))
  )
  
  log10Pe <- expression(paste("Expected -log"[10], plain(P)))
  log10Po <- expression(paste("Observed -log"[10], plain(P)))
  
  ggplot(df) +
    geom_ribbon(mapping = aes(x = expected, ymin = clower, ymax = cupper), alpha = 0.1) +
    geom_point(aes(expected, observed), size = 1.5, color = "red") +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, alpha = 0.5) +
    xlab(log10Pe) + ylab(log10Po) +
    ggtitle(title)  # Add title
}
```

# Our new model

Besides using power sum to combine gene-wise test statistics, I also
consider the maximum test statistics as one of the combinations. The
dataset we are using now is a

1.  Subset, (consider only genes within the module, and \*such that the
    library size for each cell has changed)
2.  Filtered (removing analyzing genes that have low expression among
    all cells)
3.  Normalized (divide expression by the library size)
4.  Ranked (ranking the gene-expression level)
5.  Filtered (removing cells that have high/low library size) (optional)

## Conditional resampling

```{r,eval=F}
estimate_propensity <- function (grna_assignment_matrix, covariate) {

  estimated_prop <- matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(grna_assignment_matrix), ncol = ncol(grna_assignment_matrix))

  # Loop through each row of the grna_assignment_matrix
  for (i in 1:nrow(grna_assignment_matrix)) {

    # Extract the current row from the grna_assignment_matrix
    grna_row <- as.numeric(grna_assignment_matrix[i, ])

    # Fit logistic regression model using covariates and the current row
    glm_fit <- glm(grna_row ~ ., family = binomial(link = "logit"), data = covariate)

    # Predict the fitted means (estimated probabilities) for this row
    estimated_prop[i, ] <- predict(glm_fit, type = "response")
  }
  return(estimated_prop)
}

resample_and_combine<- function(grna_assignment_matrix, n_permute) {
  propensity_matrix <- estimate_propensity(grna_assignment_matrix , covariate)

  propensity <- do.call(rbind, replicate(n_permute, propensity_matrix, simplify = FALSE))


  resampled_mat <- matrix(rbinom(n = length(propensity),
                                 size = 1,
                                 prob = as.vector(propensity)),
                          nrow = nrow(propensity),
                          ncol = ncol(propensity))

  rownames(resampled_mat) <- rep(rownames(grna_assignment_matrix),n_permute)
  combined_mat <- rbind(grna_assignment_matrix, resampled_mat)

  return(combined_mat)
}
```

```{r,echo=F}
knitr::include_graphics("images/propensity_histogram.png", error = FALSE)
```

## Scatter plots to compare gene wise P values of sceptre glm and our t test

```{r}
# Define indices
indices <- c(10, 20, 30, 120, 124)


# Loop through indices for scatter and QQ plots
for (index in indices) {
  # Extract vectors for the current index
  vector1 <- as.vector(as.matrix(gene_wise_p[index, -1]))
  vector2 <- as.vector(as.matrix(sceptre_wide[index, ]))
  
  # Filter out NA values
  valid_indices <- !is.na(vector1) & !is.na(vector2)
  filtered_vector1 <- vector1[valid_indices]
  filtered_vector2 <- vector2[valid_indices]
  
  # Scatter Plot
  plot(
    filtered_vector1, filtered_vector2,
    xlab = "Gene Wise P Values",
    ylab = "Sceptre Wide P Values",
    main = paste0("Scatter Plot for ", index, " th perturbation"),
    pch = 16,
    col = "blue",
    cex = 0.7
  )
  
  # Pause for user input to display the next plot
  # readline(prompt = "Press [Enter] to view the QQ plot for this index...")

  # QQ Plot
  qqplot(
    filtered_vector1, filtered_vector2,
    xlab = "Gene Wise P Values",
    ylab = "Sceptre Wide P Values",
    main = paste0("QQ Plot for ", index, " th perturbation"),
    pch = 16,
    col = "blue",
    cex = 0.7
  )
  abline(0, 1, col = "red", lwd = 2)
  
  # Pause again before moving to the next index
  # readline(prompt = "Press [Enter] to move to the next index...")
}

```

**When calculating gene wise P values, we take absolute value of the
test statistics and then take right-tail probability, however, the null
distribution of test statistics is not symmetric around 0. It is right
skewed and most of the test statistics are positive. Hence it lose power
to detect negative statistics when taking absolute values**

# Compare gene module discoveries

## Using ACAT to combine gene-wise p values ("External combination")

### ACAT of gene wise p from our method (i.e. t test)

```{r}
library(ACAT)
module_results <- list()

# Iterate over each row of t_gene_p_no_approximation to compute ACAT p-values for each module
for (i in seq_len(nrow(gene_wise_p))) {
  grna_id <- rownames(gene_wise_p)[i]
  p_values_row <- gene_wise_p[i,]  # Exclude grna_id column
  
  # Initialize an empty list to store ACAT p-values and module names for each module
  module_acat_pvals <- c()
  module_names <- c()
  
  # Iterate over each module in gene_modules to combine p-values using ACAT
  for (j in seq_along(gene_modules)) {
    module_name <- names(gene_modules)[j]  # Get the module name
    module_genes <- gene_modules[[j]][gene_modules[[j]] %in% colnames(p_values_row)]
    
    # Only apply ACAT if there are genes to combine and they are not NA
    if (length(module_genes) > 0) {
      module_p_values <- as.numeric(p_values_row[module_genes])
      module_p_values <- module_p_values[!is.na(module_p_values)]  # Remove NAs
      
      # Check if module_p_values still has values after removing NAs
      if (length(module_p_values) > 0) {
        acat_pval <- ACAT(module_p_values)
        module_acat_pvals <- c(module_acat_pvals, acat_pval)
        module_names <- c(module_names, module_name)
      } else {
        module_acat_pvals <- c(module_acat_pvals, NA)
        module_names <- c(module_names, module_name)
      }
    } else {
      module_acat_pvals <- c(module_acat_pvals, NA)
      module_names <- c(module_names, module_name)
    }
  }
  
  # Store results as a data frame in the list
  module_results[[i]] <- data.frame(
    grna_id = grna_id,
    module = module_names,
    acat_pval = module_acat_pvals
  )
}


# Combine all results into a single data frame
module_results_t <- do.call(rbind, module_results)

module_results_t$bh_pval <- p.adjust(module_results_t$acat_pval, method = "BH")
module_results_t$identifier <- paste(module_results_t$grna_id, module_results_t$module, sep = "_")
```

## Gene module p value by Internal combination

### minp

This gene-module p value is obtained by : 1. Obtain gene-wise test
statistics and their corresponding p value 2. Take minimum p value
within a gene module, as the test statistics 3. Use null distribution to
find final p value

```{r}
library(tibble)

minp <- read.csv("output/startover/test/minp.csv")

minp_long <- minp %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "grna_id") %>% # Add row names as a column
  pivot_longer(cols = -grna_id, names_to = "module", values_to = "p_value")

# Remove rows with NA p-values
minp_long <- minp_long %>% filter(!is.na(p_value))

# Apply global BH correction to all p-values
minp_long <- minp_long %>%
  mutate(bh_pval = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"))
```

# Comparison of discoveries of four methods

```{r}
library(eulerr)

# Define significant levels
significant_levels <- c(0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.25)


# Loop through significant levels and display plots
for (significant_level in significant_levels) {
  # Filter significant IDs for each method
  significant_ids_gene_wise_p <- module_results_sceptre$identifier[
    module_results_sceptre$bh_pval < significant_level]
  significant_ids_gene_wise_p_t <- module_results_t$identifier[
    module_results_t$bh_pval < significant_level]
  
  significant_pairs <- minp_long %>%
    filter(bh_pval < significant_level) %>%
    mutate(identifier = paste(grna_id, module, sep = "_"))
  significant_identifiers_minp <- significant_pairs$identifier
  
  significant_pairs_ours <- our_method_long %>%
    filter(bh_pval < significant_level) %>%
    mutate(identifier = paste(grna_id, module, sep = "_"))
  significant_identifiers_ours <- significant_pairs_ours$identifier
  
  # Prepare the sets
  venn_data <- list(
    `Sceptre+ACAT` = significant_ids_gene_wise_p,
    `t+ACAT` = significant_ids_gene_wise_p_t,
    `minp method` = significant_identifiers_minp,
    `Our method` = significant_identifiers_ours
  )
  
  # Generate the Euler diagram and display it
  euler_plot <- plot(euler(venn_data),
                     fills = list(fill = c("red", "blue", "green", "yellow"), alpha = 0.5),
                     edges = TRUE, quantities = TRUE,
                     main = paste("Significant Gene Modules Overlap at level", significant_level, "(10000 null)")
  )
  
  print(euler_plot)  # Display the plot in the R plotting window
}

```

```{r,echo=F}
gene_modules <- readRDS("data/gene_modules_id.rds")

gene_wise_p  <- read.csv("output/startover/no_approximation_20000/gene_wise_p.csv", nrows = 208)
sceptre <- rbind(readRDS("/project/xuanyao/jiaming/Getting_started/output/both_trans_author_threshold_0.05_2/results_run_discovery_analysis.rds")[,c(1,2,7)],
                 readRDS("/project/xuanyao/jiaming/Getting_started/output/both_trans_author_threshold_0.05_2/results_run_calibration_check.rds")[,c(1,2,7)])

sceptre$p_value[sceptre$p_value == 1] <- 1 - 1e-15
sceptre <- sceptre[!is.na(sceptre$p_value), ]
sceptre_wide <- sceptre %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = response_id, values_from = p_value) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Set the row names to be the grna_id and remove the grna_id column
rownames(sceptre_wide) <- sceptre_wide$grna_id
sceptre_wide <- sceptre_wide[, -1]

# Display the reformatted data frame
# rownames(gene_wise_p) <- gene_wise_p$X1

# Reorder rows of sceptre_wide to match gene_wise_p (subset rows by intersection)
sceptre_wide <- sceptre_wide[rownames(gene_wise_p)[rownames(gene_wise_p) %in% rownames(sceptre_wide)], ]

# Reorder columns of sceptre_wide to match gene_wise_p
sceptre_wide <- sceptre_wide[, colnames(gene_wise_p)[-1], drop = FALSE]
library(ACAT)
module_results <- list()

# Iterate over each row of t_gene_p_no_approximation to compute ACAT p-values for each module
for (i in seq_len(nrow(gene_wise_p))) {
  grna_id <- rownames(gene_wise_p)[i]
  p_values_row <- gene_wise_p[i,]  # Exclude grna_id column
  
  # Initialize an empty list to store ACAT p-values and module names for each module
  module_acat_pvals <- c()
  module_names <- c()
  
  # Iterate over each module in gene_modules to combine p-values using ACAT
  for (j in seq_along(gene_modules)) {
    module_name <- names(gene_modules)[j]  # Get the module name
    module_genes <- gene_modules[[j]][gene_modules[[j]] %in% colnames(p_values_row)]
    
    # Only apply ACAT if there are genes to combine and they are not NA
    if (length(module_genes) > 0) {
      module_p_values <- as.numeric(p_values_row[module_genes])
      module_p_values <- module_p_values[!is.na(module_p_values)]  # Remove NAs
      
      # Check if module_p_values still has values after removing NAs
      if (length(module_p_values) > 0) {
        acat_pval <- ACAT(module_p_values)
        module_acat_pvals <- c(module_acat_pvals, acat_pval)
        module_names <- c(module_names, module_name)
      } else {
        module_acat_pvals <- c(module_acat_pvals, NA)
        module_names <- c(module_names, module_name)
      }
    } else {
      module_acat_pvals <- c(module_acat_pvals, NA)
      module_names <- c(module_names, module_name)
    }
  }
  
  # Store results as a data frame in the list
  module_results[[i]] <- data.frame(
    grna_id = grna_id,
    module = module_names,
    acat_pval = module_acat_pvals
  )
}


# Combine all results into a single data frame
module_results_t <- do.call(rbind, module_results)

module_results_t$bh_pval <- p.adjust(module_results_t$acat_pval, method = "BH")
module_results_t$identifier <- paste(module_results_t$grna_id, module_results_t$module, sep = "_")
minp <- read.csv("output/startover/no_approximation_20000/minp.csv")

minp_long <- minp%>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "grna_id") %>% # Add row names as a column
  pivot_longer(cols = -grna_id, names_to = "module", values_to = "p_value")

# Remove rows with NA p-values
minp_long <- minp_long %>% filter(!is.na(p_value))

# Apply global BH correction to all p-values
minp_long <- minp_long %>%
  mutate(bh_pval = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"))

our_method <-  read.csv("output/startover/no_approximation_20000/our_method.csv")
our_method_long <- our_method %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "grna_id") %>% # Add row names as a column
  pivot_longer(cols = -grna_id, names_to = "module", values_to = "p_value")

# Remove rows with NA p-values (if any)
our_method_long <- our_method_long %>% filter(!is.na(p_value))

# Apply global BH correction to all p-values
our_method_long <- our_method_long %>%
  mutate(bh_pval = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"))
```
